name: string-instrument-tuner
title: String Instrument Tuner
summary: Chromatic microphone tuner with string presets, custom tunings, cents deviation, and reference tones.
features: Nine preset instrument families and arbitrary custom strings
Adjustable concert pitch and reference tone
limits: Microphone requires HTTPS or localhost and permission. Monophonic periodic signals about 24–1400 Hz; harmonics and noise can reduce accuracy.

name: blues-progression-atlas
title: Blues Progression Atlas
summary: Transpose classic blues forms, inspect chord tones, and audition a twelve-bar backing pattern.
features: Four original educational blues form charts
All twelve keys and chord-tone inspection
Synthesized backing playback and JSON export
limits: Educational harmonic templates; no copyrighted recordings or lyrics are bundled.

name: surfcoder-boombox
title: SurfCoder Boombox
summary: A virtual boombox for local audio queues and user-supplied radio streams, with spectrum meters.
features: Local audio queue and custom stream URLs
limits: Stream availability and formats depend on the provider. No stations or copyrighted tracks are bundled; stream requests go to the URL you choose.

name: polyrhythm-matrix
title: Polyrhythm Matrix
summary: Hear and visualize independent rhythmic cycles with tempo, subdivision, and accent control.
limits: Audio timing is subject to browser timer scheduling.

name: interval-ear-gym
title: Interval Ear Gym
summary: A randomized listening quiz with ascending, descending, and harmonic intervals and session scores.
limits: Training tones only. Playback starts after a user action.

name: chord-voicing-lab
title: Chord Voicing Lab
summary: Build and audition extended chords, inversions, and voice-leading between two harmonies.
features: Eight chord qualities in all keys
Sequence audition and JSON note export
limits: Close-position educational voicings; no automatic professional arrangement claims.

name: ambient-soundscape-mixer
title: Ambient Soundscape Mixer
summary: Mix synthesized surf, rain, wind, and drone layers locally with a sleep fade timer.
limits: Procedural noise is an approximation of natural sounds. No therapeutic claims.

name: audio-ab-loop-studio
title: Audio A–B Loop Studio
summary: Practice a selected section of a local recording with A–B markers, playback speed, and pitch preservation.
features: Local file playback and A–B markers
limits: Loop precision and pitch preservation depend on browser media implementation.

name: pocket-drum-foundry
title: Pocket Drum Foundry
summary: Program a sixteen-step synthesized drum groove with swing, per-voice levels, and pattern export.
limits: Browser timers can introduce jitter. No hardware drum samples are included.

name: spectrogram-waterfall
title: Spectrogram Waterfall
summary: Inspect microphone or local audio as a scrolling frequency heatmap with adjustable range.
features: Four FFT resolutions and range selection
limits: Microphone requires HTTPS/localhost and permission. This is a relative magnitude display, not a calibrated measurement instrument.

name: wav-loudness-auditor
title: WAV Loudness Auditor
summary: Measure PCM WAV peaks, RMS, clipping, DC offset, and crest factor with per-channel JSON reports.
features: Per-channel peak, RMS, crest factor and DC offset
limits: PCM16 uncompressed WAV only; RMS is not integrated LUFS and sample peaks are not intersample true peaks.
usage: Generate synthetic audio with `python examples/make_fixture.py`, then run `python app.py examples/demo.wav`. Supply your own PCM16 WAV path to measure it without modifying it.

name: midi-file-inspector
title: MIDI File Inspector
summary: Parse Standard MIDI Files, running status, tempo events, track names, and note counts.
features: Standard MIDI header and track parsing
Tempo, track names and note-event counts
limits: Reads Standard MIDI Files; reports ticks rather than claiming an exact elapsed duration across SMPTE/tempo maps.
usage: Run `cargo run -- examples/demo.mid`. The built executable also accepts any supported `.mid` file. Truncated chunks and malformed status bytes are rejected.

name: scale-fingering-planner
title: Scale Fingering Planner
summary: Map scale notes to any fretted string tuning and export positions as JSON or readable tablature.
features: Custom string tuning and fret range
Major, natural minor, minor pentatonic and blues scales
Pitch class, scale degree and MIDI position export
limits: Equal-tempered fret maps; does not infer optimal physical hand fingering or account for microtonal/fretless instruments.
usage: Example: `go run . --root 9 --scale blues --tuning 40,45,50,55,59,64 --frets 5`. Root 9 is A. Output lists each string/fret containing a scale tone.

name: sample-pack-cataloger
title: Sample Pack Cataloger
summary: Index WAV libraries in SQLite, detect duplicate audio files, and search by duration and sample rate.
limits: Uncompressed WAV formats supported by Python wave; duplicates mean identical files, not perceptually identical recordings. Missing files are retained until the index is rebuilt.
usage: Index: `python app.py /path/to/samples --db catalog.sqlite`. Search: `python app.py --db catalog.sqlite --search kick --minimum 0.2`. Scanning writes only the catalog, never audio files.

name: wav-channel-toolkit
title: WAV Channel Toolkit
summary: Split PCM16 stereo recordings into mono channels or reverse frames without corrupting channel order.
limits: PCM16 mono/stereo only; files are loaded into memory. Does not decode compressed audio or preserve ancillary RIFF metadata.
usage: Build, then run `./wav-toolkit left examples/demo.wav left.wav` or `./wav-toolkit reverse examples/demo.wav reversed.wav`. Existing output files are rejected.

name: impulse-response-forge
title: Impulse Response Forge
summary: Generate deterministic stereo delay impulse-response WAV files for convolution experiments.
limits: Synthetic sparse delay responses, not measured rooms. Twelve taps maximum; values are bounded to PCM range.
usage: Build and run `./impulse-forge room-ir.wav 125 0.65 2`. Import the output into a convolution processor. Choose a new output filename each time.

name: setlist-flow-planner
title: Setlist Flow Planner
summary: Order a setlist using tempo and tonal-distance costs, with fixed openers and a transition report.
limits: Greedy heuristic, not a globally optimal setlist. Key must be a circle-of-fifths index 0–11; major/minor mode and musical style are not inferred.
usage: Create a JSON array with `title`, `bpm`, and `key` (circle-of-fifths index, e.g. C=0, G=1, D=2). Run `dotnet run -- examples/songs.json`. The first input stays the opener.

name: lyrics-rhyme-notebook
title: Lyrics Rhyme Notebook
summary: Keep original lyric fragments in a local JSON notebook and search approximate suffix rhymes.
features: Atomic JSON save for new fragments
limits: English spelling suffix heuristic, not phonetic rhyme detection. Homophones and irregular pronunciations can be missed.
usage: Add: `ruby app.rb add "Your original line"`. Search: `ruby app.rb rhyme night`. Use `--file path.json` to choose a notebook. No copyrighted lyric corpus is bundled.

name: podcast-chapter-builder
title: Podcast Chapter Builder
summary: Convert timestamped chapter notes into validated Podcasting 2.0 chapter JSON.
limits: Plain timestamp/title TSV only. Output does not alter the audio file; redirect stdout to a new chapter JSON file.
setup:
- uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
usage: Create a TSV with `00:00<TAB>Introduction` and subsequent increasing timestamps. Run `java Main chapters.tsv > chapters.json`. Each chapter requires a nonblank title.

name: practice-session-composer
title: Practice Session Composer
summary: Allocate focused music-practice blocks using weighted priorities and export a timed Markdown plan.
limits: Planning tool only; does not listen to performance, assess technique, or prescribe physical exercise.
setup:
- uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.10.2'
usage: Edit `examples/priorities.tsv` with name TAB positive-weight rows. Run `gradle run --args="45 examples/priorities.tsv" --quiet`. Integer minutes are allocated with the largest-remainder method.

name: local-rag-notebook
title: Local RAG Notebook
summary: Retrieve cited document chunks with BM25 and optionally answer using a local Ollama model.
run: python app.py examples "How are ocean waves measured?"
demo: python app.py examples "How are ocean waves measured?"
limits: Lexical retrieval. Generation requires an installed Ollama model and is not exercised by offline tests; verify model citations.
usage: Run `python app.py examples "wave period"` for cited retrieval. Optionally append `--model YOUR_INSTALLED_MODEL` after installing Ollama and a model. Selected chunks and the question go only to localhost:11434.
architecture: BM25 implements document frequency, term saturation, and length normalization. File paths and chunk numbers accompany each excerpt. Optional generation uses Ollama /api/chat with stream=false.

name: prompt-evaluation-bench
title: Prompt Evaluation Bench
summary: Score model responses against reproducible contains, forbidden-text, and regular-expression checks.
limits: String and regex checks assess specified criteria, not general truthfulness. Live inference needs a separately installed model.
usage: Cases require unique `id`, `prompt`, and at least one `contains`, `forbidden`, or `regex` assertion. Offline mode uses `response`; `--model NAME` calls local Ollama. Treat regex configurations as trusted input.

name: embedding-neighbor-map
title: Embedding Neighbor Map
summary: Explore document similarity using transparent TF-IDF vectors and a nearest-neighbor graph.
limits: Lexical baseline rather than pretrained semantic embeddings. Graph positions use a circular layout, not learned dimensionality reduction.

name: tiny-neural-network-playground
title: Tiny Neural Network Playground
summary: Train a two-layer neural network on XOR and inspect its decision boundary and loss.
features: XOR decision boundary and cross-entropy loss
limits: Educational four-hidden-unit neural network, not a general-purpose pretrained model.

name: naive-bayes-mail-lab
title: Naive Bayes Mail Lab
summary: Train and evaluate a Laplace-smoothed text classifier with readable per-token evidence.
run: go run . examples/training.json "team meeting project schedule"
demo: go run . examples/training.json "team meeting project schedule"
features: Inspectable log scores and vocabulary size
limits: Toy local classifier; scores are not calibrated probabilities. Examples are insufficient for production spam filtering.
usage: Training JSON contains `label` and `text` rows. Run `go run . examples/training.json "your sample"`. The highest log score is the prediction. Unknown tokens are ignored.

name: knn-signal-classifier
title: KNN Signal Classifier
summary: Classify numeric feature vectors using standardized nearest neighbors and confidence votes.
limits: Requires labelled numeric features; does not automatically extract audio features. Vote share is not calibrated confidence.
usage: TSV rows use `label<TAB>number,number`. Run `cargo run -- examples/signals.tsv "115,0.25" 3`. Standardization is computed from the training rows only.

name: local-model-chat-desk
title: Local Model Chat Desk
summary: Chat with installed Ollama models through a localhost-only server, with conversation export.
features: Real local Ollama chat with conversation history
Same-origin loopback proxy and JSON export
limits: Requires Ollama and a downloaded model. The interface displays an unavailable state rather than fabricated responses.
usage: Install Ollama and pull a model using its official instructions. Start Ollama, run `python server.py`, and open localhost:8080. Select a model and send a message. No external model host is configured. Offline tests validate payload handling, not inference.
architecture: The loopback HTTP server proxies only model discovery and chat to localhost:11434. Host/origin and payload sizes are checked. Output is rendered as text. Conversation state is in memory until an explicit export.

name: ai-dataset-quality-auditor
title: AI Dataset Quality Auditor
summary: Audit JSONL datasets for malformed rows, duplicate prompts, split leakage, and possible sensitive fields.
limits: Heuristic data-quality checks, not comprehensive sensitive-data detection or training-data approval.
usage: Input JSONL needs string `prompt` and `completion` fields and an optional `split`. Findings include line numbers and redact matched email values.

name: decision-tree-workbench
title: Decision Tree Workbench
summary: Train a small CART classifier, inspect readable split rules, and query new feature values.
limits: Trained on supplied examples, with no held-out accuracy claim. Chart axes are fixed to 0–10.

name: surfcoder-regional-surf-report
title: SurfCoder Regional Surf Report
summary: Choose a surf region or coordinates and compare live marine forecasts, swell periods, directions, and wind.
features: Eleven regions and 26 coastal locations plus custom coordinates
Seven-day live wave, swell and wind forecasts
Local-time day selection, metric/imperial units, saved location and CSV
limits: Offshore grid forecasts do not resolve every beach break, tide, current, hazard, or local wind effect. Check conditions locally and follow lifeguard guidance.
usage: Choose a region and forecast location, or enter coastal coordinates and select Use custom coordinates. Choose units and a day. Save a location only on your device, or download CSV. Forecast requests send the chosen coordinates to marine-api.open-meteo.com and api.open-meteo.com; no geolocation permission or API key is used. Data errors remain visible and are never replaced by invented live conditions.
architecture: The static browser client joins Open-Meteo marine/wind forecasts by Unix timestamp and formats time in the returned location timezone. Marine forecasts use cell_selection=sea. Abort/sequence controls prevent an old location request from overwriting a new one. Wind failures do not hide available marine data. Values remain null when absent. Links attribute Open-Meteo and its source datasets. See official marine API documentation for licensing and commercial usage terms.

name: home-energy-scenario-lab
title: Home Energy Scenario Lab
summary: Compare appliance schedules, energy use, and tariff costs with a downloadable scenario report.
limits: Simple constant-power scenario model, not measured household usage or a billing prediction. No utility credentials are requested.

name: offline-recipe-scaling-kit
title: Offline Recipe Scaling Kit
summary: Scale structured ingredient quantities and servings without rounding intermediate measurements.
features: Validated servings and unchanged ingredient units
limits: Does not convert units, infer cooking times, or assess allergens/nutrition. Scaling cooking technique requires judgement.
usage: Run `./recipe-kit examples/recipe.json 6`. JSON contains `title`, positive `servings`, and `ingredients` with name/quantity/unit. Output goes to stdout; the input remains unchanged.

name: network-subnet-workbench
title: Network Subnet Workbench
summary: Inspect IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR networks, membership, address counts, and subnet splits offline.
limits: Offline address arithmetic only; no network scanning. IPv6 has no broadcast address. Usable-host conventions are explicitly labelled.
usage: Inspect: `go run . --cidr 2001:db8::/64`. Split: `go run . --cidr 192.168.10.0/24 --split 26`. Add `--contains ADDRESS` for membership. IPv4 /31 and /32 host counts follow point-to-point/single-address conventions.

name: sqlite-migration-rehearsal
title: SQLite Migration Rehearsal
summary: Rehearse SQL migrations against a temporary database copy and report schema changes before application.
features: SQLite backup API to a temporary copy
Schema diff and post-migration row counts
limits: Rehearses trusted SQLite SQL only; does not apply migrations to production or validate other database engines. Large files require temporary disk space.
usage: Run `python app.py database.sqlite migration.sql`. The source opens read-only and is backed up to a temporary database before SQL runs. The tool never applies changes to the source. ATTACH/DETACH are denied.

name: password-entropy-playground
title: Password Entropy Playground
summary: Compare explicit password-generation models and generate random passphrases entirely on-device.
features: Web Crypto passphrase generation with rejection sampling
limits: Entropy applies only to independent uniform generation. The compact bundled word list needs more words than a large Diceware list for equal entropy.

name: portable-invoice-ledger
title: Portable Invoice Ledger
summary: Generate itemized invoice JSON using integer cents, explicit tax basis points, and validated quantities.
features: Explicit tax basis points and discounts
Optional locked JSONL ledger with duplicate-ID prevention
limits: Calculation and recordkeeping only; no payment processing or tax-rule determination. Tax rate/currency must be supplied by the user.
usage: Run `php app.php invoice.json`. Values are integer cents; `tax_bps: 825` means 8.25%. Optional `--ledger history.jsonl` appends under a lock and rejects repeated IDs. Zero tax must be explicit; no tax jurisdiction is inferred.

name: dependency-license-board
title: Dependency License Board
summary: Inventory package manifests and local license files into an evidence-based dependency report.
limits: Does not resolve transitive dependencies or infer legal license compatibility. Review actual package license evidence before distribution.
usage: Run `python app.py /path/to/project`. It reads only direct package.json/requirements.txt and root LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE files. It performs no network lookup or package installation. Unknown licenses remain unknown.

name: color-accessibility-studio
title: Color Accessibility Studio
summary: Compare WCAG contrast pairs, preview text sizes, and export accessible color tokens.
features: WCAG relative luminance and contrast ratios
AA/AAA normal and large text checks
Live preview, color swapping and CSS tokens
limits: Contrast ratio checks are only one part of accessibility; they do not certify full WCAG conformance.

name: calendar-ics-conflict-lens
title: Calendar ICS Conflict Lens
summary: Inspect UTC calendar events and find overlapping time ranges with explicit unsupported-rule reporting.
limits: Explicit UTC DTSTART/DTEND VEVENTs only; recurring, all-day, timezone-local and duration-only events must be normalized first.
setup:
- uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
usage: Run `java Main calendar.ics`. Supported events need unique UID, DTSTART and DTEND as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ. Events touching at an endpoint do not conflict. Unsupported recurrence/timezone rules fail explicitly.

name: markdown-link-health-map
title: Markdown Link Health Map
summary: Check relative Markdown links and anchor targets locally without sending files to a remote crawler.
features: ATX heading anchors with duplicate suffixes
Missing/out-of-root findings and nonzero exit status
limits: Small Markdown subset: inline links and ATX headings. Reference links, HTML anchors, complex nested-parenthesis URLs and complete CommonMark parsing are unsupported. No network requests.
usage: Run `cargo run -- docs-directory`. Relative paths are resolved from each Markdown file. Paths outside the supplied root are flagged. Exit 0 means no issues in the supported subset; 1 means broken links; 2 means input/read errors.
